results.title: Riley County announces upcoming road work projects
results.description: Riley County public works director John Ellermann highlighted two projects that will begin work next week during the Riley County commission meeting on Monday.

results.title: Osun Election: A Strategic Setback or a Political Defeat?
results.description: The Osun result is undoubtedly significant, but the bigger question is what it actually represents. Is it evidence of a weakening APC, a rejection of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, or simply a setback in one state?
